name: 11749 · Islandia, NY
findings: ZIP 11749 (Islandia) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (63%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11749 (Islandia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11749 (Islandia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.5 times the typical level).
